BEGIN;
DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM course_plan_request WHERE initial_allocation_json IS NOT NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'initial allocation evidence exists'; END IF; END $$;
DROP TRIGGER trg_initial_allocation_checkpoint ON course_plan_request;
DROP FUNCTION protect_initial_allocation_checkpoint();
ALTER TABLE course_plan_request DROP CONSTRAINT ck_initial_allocation_pair, DROP COLUMN initial_allocation_json, DROP COLUMN initial_allocation_hash;
COMMIT;
